Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music Stonebwoy featured on soundtrack for Hollywood action comedy ‘Wrong Toes’ Source : Joy Entertainment 28 October 2026 11:28am Audio By Carbonatix
Ghanaian musician Stonebwoy has joined an international collaboration featured on the official soundtrack of upcoming action comedy Boyz Trip , scheduled for worldwide theatrical release in 2027.
The award-winning recording artist features on Wrong Toes , a song bringing together Stonebwoy from Ghana, American recording artist Mashanda Faust and Atlanta-based musical group Hero The Band, blending African and American musical influences.
The Boyz Trip entertainment project, comprising the feature film, its original soundtrack and the Wrong Toes music video, is executive produced by Alan Key and Kyle Scott, co-founders of KeyScott Entertainment, headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
The concept for Wrong Toes originated with Alan Key, whose creative vision laid the foundation for the song and its accompanying music video. Kyle Scott spearheaded the creative development and execution of that vision, bringing the project together musically and visually while working alongside recording artist Mashanda Faust to shape the song’s musical direction and overall presentation.
Written by Alan Key and Faten El Sayed, Wrong Toes has evolved into an international collaboration featuring artists from Ghana and the United States.
The official music video was recently filmed at Cape Town Film Studios in Cape Town, South Africa, with two-time award-winning creative director Warren Gray leading its creative direction.
Stonebwoy’s participation presents another opportunity to showcase Ghanaian music through international cinema.
Known for his blend of Afrobeats, reggae and dancehall, Stonebwoy contributes his signature sound to a soundtrack designed to connect audiences across Africa, North America, Europe and Australia.
His collaboration with American artists Mashanda Faust and Hero The Band also underscores the growing creative relationship between the African and American entertainment industries.
Wrong Toes is part of a collection of original music being developed for the Boyz Trip soundtrack through KeyScott Entertainment’s newly launched music division, which focuses on original film music, publishing, artist development and international collaborations.
Boyz Trip is an upcoming international action comedy starring Desi Banks, Rome Flynn, Algee Smith and South African actor Siv Ngesi.
Set against the backdrop of Cape Town, South Africa, the film follows four longtime college friends who reunite for what is supposed to be an unforgettable international vacation.
However, their dream getaway quickly spirals into chaos when they become entangled in the dangerous world of a notorious criminal figure known as Le Serpent.
What begins as a celebration of friendship turns into an action-packed comedy filled with unexpected twists, dangerous encounters and unforgettable moments.
The film blends Hollywood-style action comedy with African culture, international locations and a globally influenced soundtrack.
Boyz Trip is executive produced by Alan Key and Kyle Scott under the banner of KeyScott Entertainment, an international film and television production company headquartered in Brisbane, Australia.
The film is directed by Kyle Scott, an American filmmaker and executive producer whose international production experience spans more than 41 countries across six continents.
Boyz Trip is being prepared for an international theatrical rollout in 2027, with official release date announcements expected in early 2027.

Further announcements regarding the film’s theatrical distribution, official soundtrack, music releases and promotional activities are expected as the production approaches its 2027 launch.
KeyScott Entertainment is an international film, television and music production company based in Brisbane, Australia, focused on developing commercially driven entertainment for global audiences.
Through its expanding music division, the company is developing original soundtracks, music publishing opportunities, artist collaborations and new platforms for bringing international musical talent into film and television.
The upcoming release of Boyz Trip and its associated soundtrack forms part of the company’s broader vision to connect storytelling, music and culture across international markets.
